facts.fact: NITA's eGovernment Interoperability Framework version 2.0, labelled a draft for stakeholder review, sets eGIF standards for government systems across technical annexes on data, network, service-oriented architecture, channels, business process, security and applications interoperability; the captured text carries no printed date, so 2022 is the published-date proxy.

note: No fact on use: the document says eGIF compliance review will gate project funding, which is a text describing itself, not a law or a named body checked against the standards.
